title: Reproducibility package for From Residual Candidates to Population Inference: Auditing Early Excesses in Type Ia Supernova Forced Photometry
description: Frozen inputs, contracts, scripts, trial-level outputs, old/current causal-reconciliation ledgers, exact conditional sign distributions, population-sensitivity products, and external-catalogue audit tables supporting the revised manuscript PASP-102523. The primary end-to-end endpoint has zero measured recovery and therefore supplies no occurrence constraint for the tested proxy-endpoint pairs.
